name: Gap
outlook:
What Gap says to expect

  • Full year fiscal 2026: net salesThe Company's updated full-year net sales outlook of up 1% to 1.5% now assumes Old Navy comparable sales of flat to down 1%, compared with the prior range of flat to up 1%, reflecting the brand's second-quarter performance.
  • Full year fiscal 2026: diluted earnings per shareOn a reported basis, the Company now expects full year diluted earnings per share to be approximately $3.77 to $3.87.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed August 27, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
